reviews.title: Lanmei Airlines: Excellent service for the disabled
reviews.text: I would like to congratulate Lanmei Airlines on their excellent service for disabled passengers. Recently I injured my right leg so I cannot walk but I needed to go to Bangkok. My flights were booked through Lanmei Airlines, which is a Cambodian budget airline which does short trips within the South East Asian region. I used my own wheelchair, right to the aircraft cabin and then they stored my wheelchair in the baggage storage compartment which I later collected at the baggage claim. They did also provide a wheelchair when we landed to take me through immigration and to baggage claim. The check in staff and air crew are all very helpful, very understanding and will do whatever they to help the disabled passenger. I would like to highlight these details of their service. When we waiting for the flight to Bangkok, there was very, very heavy rain outside and they had a bus waiting for the able bodied passengers to transport them to the airplane. But those who were in wheelchairs were escorted to a driven mobile room, which lifted the wheelchair to the door of this mobile room, and then pushed the wheelchair passengers into this room. Then the driver of the mobile room drove to the aircraft, parked it right next to another door of the airplane, and then got the people in wheelchairs out. Each wheelchair passenger was then place on a another small chair-with wheels (or a very small wheelchair which also fits in the aisle of the plane). this small chair fitted in the aisle on the plane, using this chair they gently pushed each disabled passenger to their seat on the plane. This was carried out brilliantly with so much safety and protection for the wheelchair passenger, I greatly admire them for this service and they are to be commended on carrying this out with such care. I have never seen this on the international airlines and in all my years of traveling. I did not even know that such service existed. And I was allocated an excellent seat with a lot of leg room, which I did not pay for. I was able to travel comfortably. If you are flying in South East Asia with a disabled person or you are temporarily disabled, I highly recommend Lanmei Airlines. They will take good care of you!
reviews.author: Winsome66

reviews.title: From Check in till arrival, all good
reviews.text: To be honest, I was a bit skeptical after reading reviews but I must say, check in was perfect, nice staff at counter, flight boarding was as it should be , onboard staff friendly and smiling, aircraft seating was clean and flight was spot on time. It's a low-cost and cheap, brought me from Bangkok to Phnom Penh, for me perfect
reviews.author: Sammypla

reviews.title: Unfriendly & Unhelpful Staff
reviews.text: Staff is very unfriendly and unhelpful, They seem to be unhappy with their jobs and come across as very uneducated.
reviews.author: John Doe

reviews.title: Ignore bad reviews
reviews.text: Honestly I was a skeptic after reading so many bad reviews but my flight was seamless! Just do what the airline suggests…get there early, check in, have your documents ready and you will have no trouble! Genuinely was a great flight, on time and plenty of baggage! Would recommend to those who don’t muck around

reviews.title: Must Avoid this Airline
reviews.text: 2 times with Lamei. First one they canceled. Second flight they delay. No idea why this airline listed on earth. The ground staff treat customer very bad, very rude and unprofessional

reviews.title: Cheap and not professional.
reviews.text: I never see anything like this in my life, they delay 8hr I asked them and their answer was “I am not sure when the flight will take off. This is the first and the last time I would never flights with this air line ever again.

reviews.title: AVOID THIS AIRLINES
reviews.text: Avoid this airlines it's one of the wrost. The ground stuffs are unprofessional. During checking in they just asked me vailed return ticket and even a hotel booking it was alright till that. But after custom clearance they called my name on speaker and asked me a lot of documents which is totally unnecessary and forced me to book hotels for the whole trip even asking me to show them cash $2000 for each person it's totally unnecessary. reviews.title: Awful Staff and Horrible Flight Experience!!!
reviews.text: Why would the desk clerk say that he wouldn't give me the boarding pass unless I present an outbound ticket from Malaysia even though it's not required and had me pay for a flight that I wouldn't use just to let me get the boarding pass to catch my flight?!!! I am travelling from Cambodia to Malaysia and in Malaysia they never ask us about anything to enter the country!
reviews.author: Ahmad

reviews.title: Economical price, bag included, on time and safe
reviews.text: Had a very good experience with Lanmei. Purchased their ticket over others because their price already included a checked bag Everything went smoothly, announcements were clear, crew courteous, flight safe and on time. Nothing to complain about, totally recommended!
reviews.author: Gari K

reviews.title: 3 hours delay. Total lack of customer service.
reviews.text: Plane was delayed three hours with no explanations or updates. This was stressful as we had a connecting flight. Plane was dirty. Certainly no evidence of covid cleaning here at all!! Once onboard we were expected to pay $1 for water even when I explained we had spent all our currency during the 3 hour wait. Not a pleasant experience at all. I would NEVER use this airline again.
reviews.author: Neil A

reviews.title: Don't transfer them any money, it is too difficul to get refund when they cancel the flight!
reviews.text: On 13 september 2022, i purchased a ticket from Ho Chi Minh city to Phnom Penh, the airline is called Lanmei airline. A few days after that, the airlines cancelled my flight by themselves, they said it is due to operational issue. Until now, i do not get refund yet and i already ask both Traveloka and Lanmei airline about this but it does not really helpful, Traveloka said the refund process can be up to 90 days, shorter or longer and they are not sure when i can get refund. Be careful guys, doing business with Traveloka and Lanmei airlines will only waste your time and money, i do not know what they do with our money in that 90 days, they should not keep our money for that long unless for investment activity?....ironically, it only needed 1 hour to fly and 10 minutes to purchase the ticket but 90 days to refund money that is not theirs. I only wished i can get second chance to buy ticket from another airline and from another website.
reviews.author: Don S
reviews.route: Ho Chi Minh City - Phnom Penh

reviews.title: DREADFUL!! Do not use them! Cancelled Flight Twice!
reviews.text: We knew these were trouble when they cancelled the second stage of our flight to Siam Reap and literally dumped us in Pnohm Pehn with no accommodation. Our return flight on 31/12/21 was cancelled 12hrs before takeoff and an alternative flight of 8th Jan offered not good when your flight to U.K. leaves Bangkok on the 2/1/22. Honestly avoid stress and do not deal with this unprofessional airline
reviews.author: Tracey R

reviews.title: Cancelled outbound flight... days later cancelled the return flight.
reviews.text: They cancelled my outgoing flight just days before it was supposed to fly. At the last minute I was able to scramble to get a replacement flight, but of course it was 4x the price, because it was a last-minute one-way flight. After they cancelled the first flight, they asked if I wanted a refund. Of course I want a refund. So they informed me that they would have to cancel the return flight as well, to process my refund. So of course I told them not to do that. Then a couple days later they cancelled the return flight. Time to go shopping for another last-minute one-way flight.
reviews.author: SamBaudotBrown

reviews.title: First and Last time I will use them!
reviews.text: Awful airline! No sooner had I booked then the next day they changed the flight time from 5pm to 9am, which meant 16 hours wait in Bangkok on return. Couldn´t reach them to cancel or book another flight. Also, it was impossible to check in online without an ID number, which I was never given by either of the booking agents. I emailed Lanmei several times without answer. I subsequently couldn´t leave Hamburg (for BKK) because Emirates were unable to reach Lanmei to check my bags right through! Now I´m trying to cancel both my flights but unable to reach anybody at Lanmei. A lesson learned and money down the drain. Just a disgusting airline!
reviews.author: phil c

reviews.title: Terrible airlines
reviews.text: My worst experience so far. NOT professional Airlines! I was speechless when the check-in staff told me that my flight can't be connected to Osaka via Hong Kong, so I can't board the flight from Phnom Penh to Hong Kong (I was sure it can when I booked my ticket - NOT self-transit). After about 30 mins talking and checking my ticket, they said No refund for me, and I have to book another flight. No other choice. I was very angry and disappointed at the same, how could this happen? Left with no choice sitting in the waiting lounge, I booked another flight (depart the same day later in the evening). When I was walking out of the lounge, the staff was running and called me that I can board after they checked again (by this time, the plane was supposed to take off in 2 mins). I ran with them to check in my luggage and through all the checkpoints as you can imagine in the airport. Running while cancelling my other flight. luckily I could cancel without charge. All these said, they should have checked properly my ticket in the first place!
reviews.author: touch2018

reviews.title: Bangkok to Phnom Penh
reviews.text: Really short, pleasant flight - left my flat in Pattaya 7am, taxi to Suvanarbhumi, flight was around 11, arrived in Phnom Penh 12.45. Through customs in 5 minutes - airport very comfortable and uncrowded. It took 40 mins, service was great, no meal but return ticket was around $120. Spent my time looking out of the window and looking forward to Cambodia. Return flight was the same - no nonsense, no fuss, quick with no questions asked - the easy life.
reviews.author: Jeff B

reviews.title: Flightless and stranded in sihanoukville
reviews.text: We booked this flight direct with the airline's website about 5 weeks before we were due to fly and they took our money ($ 240) promptly through PayPal as they wouldn't accept cards. They sent the itinerary by email and we were advised to check in at the desk 2 hours prior to departure. We arrived at the airport in plenty of time but the flight was not on the board. We approached Cambodia air's desk and they advised that the flight had been cancelled. We had had no email advising us of this and no refund. We were stranded in the nightmare that is sihanoukville along with 5 other passengers and we had already paid for a hotel in Phnom Penh. We had to get a taxi which cost extra money and 4 1/2 hours of a nightmare journey. We telephoned the airline and they told us to respond to the confirmation email for a refund. One week later and a talk with a lanmei airline's rep at Phnom Penh airport and we still have not had a refund. Appalling.
reviews.author: Jane

reviews.title: Fast refund
reviews.text: Our flight time was changed by Lanmei and this would not work with our plans. They refunded the entire purchase price within one week...no question asked. While we have not flown Lanmei so can’t comment on that part of their service, I’m very impressed with their quick response and refund.
reviews.author: rgadavis

reviews.title: The best part is the Name
reviews.text: What's in a name for me everything, Lanmei English pronuncation says it all you want.. to take off on time and the Lanmei (land me). That's what you get, say for a food service trolly running into your knee or great confussion at the disembarcation in SR with passangers from BKK and PP trying to decide who who should get off when. If you like some comedy when you fly Lanmei is for you.
reviews.author: mrdee999

reviews.title: All good for me
reviews.text: I travel a lot for work from Australia to Asia with large and safe airlines like Qantas. Reading some of the reviews, I was a bit reluctant booking with Lanmei Air for a return trip to Cambodia from Hong Kong. But all in all on both flights my experience with Lanmei has been great, courteous service, no flight delay, smooth and safe flight and good value for money. I would fly with them again, although just like any other low cost airline, the leg room is limited for tall people like me.
reviews.author: huxley99999

reviews.title: Not bad

It landed alittle earlier then expected too. It seemed safe enough and the plane new enough. Service wasn't the friendliest though so lose a star but I'd fly again for sure!

The airplane also good and clean. However the sound of airplane machine is a little bit noisy compare with other airplane on my experience. Overall good flying with lanmei airlines.

reviews.title: Tragedy
reviews.text: Terrible. No one answers the phone and a few days before we were supposed to fly they cancel the flight. It is impossible to find a person who speak english in a way that is acceptable and understandable. No one answers email or answers in a way that you only can say WTF??. BEWARE. AVOID.
reviews.author: Peter P

reviews.title: Worst Airline - Avoid it
reviews.text: As a frequent flyer, who flew all over the world, this is one of the worst airlines I have seen. Staff at Siem Reap airport was very rude, telling weird rules those I have never seen in any airline, they shock you with demand to immediately show $600 in cash per person if you want to fly. The supervisor was so rude that he just said once sentence and hanged up the phone. Staff threatened me multiple times of not letting me board if I don’t do this or do that. Avoid this flight, there are many other good airlines operating in Cambodia.
reviews.author: Dev

reviews.title: Great Domestic Flight
reviews.text: Great flight. The airline was clean and on time. No complaints at all. I’d definitely recommend them for flying within Asia.
reviews.author: SF Guy

reviews.title: Deliberate overbooking, deliberate lies and total contempt for the customer.
reviews.text: If you expect a reliable and honest service then please avoid Lanmei. My family arrived at Siem Reap this morning to fly to Phnom Penh. We were 2 adults and four (sick) children (9,7,3 years old) and a 7 week old baby. Total cost of tickets booked 11 days ago: $800 USD. Lanmei had deliberately overbooked the flight and had closed the check-in counter early, which meant we could not even plead with them to honour the tickets. Ground staff said Lanmei would come and talk to us. Lanmei did so only after our flight had departed. Lanmei said “the system” meant that the plane was already full. Lanmei admitted they (not “the system”) had deliberately overbooked the flight and bumped us and three others off. All other flights from Siem Reap were fully booked. Lanmei refused to pay for taxi or bus transport. As a result of this we have had to travel to Phnom Penh (5 hours on a dangerous road) and we have already missed our connection in Phnom Penh. This company has displayed total contempt for us as customers. Q1. Who is the dishonest person who decides to overbook the flight without warning us of this shabby practice? Q2. Why does that person insult us by offering a fake apology only after the flight has departed?
reviews.author: Sean O

reviews.title: Very professional airline all around -- I was impressed!
reviews.text: When I was trying to decide about taking internal flights in Cambodia to save time sitting on a bus, I saw a number of very mixed reviews on Lanmei Airlines, which made me nervous. But I proceeded to book 3 flights with them and figured I'd just take my chances. As it turns out, all three of my flights (PNH -> REP, REP -> KOS, and KOS -> PNH) were amazing. From check in, to boarding at the gate, to the friendliness of the flight attendants, to the on-time take offs and arrivals (actually TWO of the three flights pulled back from the gate 7 - 8 minutes EARLY), to quick baggage delivery -- everything about Lanmei was professional. I really have no idea why there were so many negative reviews. Granted, Lanmei is a new airline with only 2 years of service under its belt so far. But, in fact, I noticed that the competing domestic carriers in Cambodia had many cancelled flights on the same days that I was flying--yet the Lanmei flights departed as scheduled. So, I'm glad I took a chance with Lanmei and would fly with them again in a heartbeat in Cambodia. The only downside I experienced was that they don't accept credit cards when you book online -- only Pay Pal and a couple of other options that I think are more commonly used in Asia. For 2 of my 3 flights, I booked through kiwi.com, and the other flight, I booked very easily through a travel agency in Siem Reap.
reviews.author: KPR777

reviews.title: Average, but may be the best choice
reviews.text: Lanmei is a low cost carrier out of China. When picking out a carrier for the flight between Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, it may be the best choice. The reason for this, is that in most cases (not all), the other airlines are flying ATR-72's, instead of Lanmei's A320's. What this means is that you get faster flights and more baggage allowance. For many people, that's worth it. The flight itself is quick, which is good, because the rows of seats are really crammed together. If you're a Westerner, it's likely going to feel cramped, with your knees pressed into the seat in front of you. For this short flight, the cabin crew are practically non-existent. After the flight reaches cruising altitude, they retreat behind curtains at the front galley, and don't reappear until it's time to prepare the cabin for arrival. There is no food or drinks served on this short flight, so I guess they take advantage of the opportunity to rest. The plane seemed to be in decent shape, and I didn't feel unsafe in any way. We left about 30 or 40 minutes late, which according to Flight Aware, is pretty average for this airline. I'd fly them again, if I needed to fly this route. But I'd manage my expectations when it comes to service, space, and timeliness.
reviews.author: Ian Robert K

reviews.title: Could be better, but I rate average as long we don`t crash, terrible is fatal
reviews.text: Check in and everything was normal, Phnom Penh has a relativly ok airport, boarding was good, airplane, this is my field of expertice, I can`t say anything about the technical condition on the Airplane, but it was an older Airbus A320 and it was a bitt weared out interior, the flight was a bitt weird, I fly a lot and the flying seemed a bitt unexperienced, I was unsure we would land in one piece after the flight but comforted my self by thinking he has probably had a landing or two before and the weather was good.....and he did hand it he could not speak english tough, but the pilot tried I give him for that, i felt Lanmei was a bitt low standard in every way, I cant tell how well their planes is maintained but i know Cambodia is one of the poorest countries in Asia, it might or might not impact the maintinance, they have no serious incidents, but they are a relativly new airline, if the weather forecast show poor weather i would book another airline. But our flight was ok except the weird flying, very sudden movements in all manouvers unlike anything i have experienced before and i do fly a lot.
reviews.author: Øyvind N

reviews.title: Convenient flight
reviews.text: This flight was booked for us by our travel agent while traveling in Cambodia. It's a short flight, only about 45 minutes. The time of the flight (departure at 17:45) is very convenient because you still have time to visit Siem Reap during the day and the landing time in Phnom Penh is not too late (around 18:30). Our flight was on time and the staff was very friendly.
reviews.author: Enjay71

reviews.title: Can’t help but feel a little bit cheated by Lanmei Airlines
reviews.text: I booked my flights to and from Siem Reap just a few days before travelling. The fare from Bangkok was reasonable at around £80 return. On booking, the home page showed colourful icons with references to food and seat selection, so I, perhaps stupidly, believed that I would benefit from these extras by choosing Lanmei. I was wrong. Aside from a 25kg baggage allowance, nothing is free with this airline. Absolutely nothing. For travel between Bangkok and Phnom Penh or Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, this airline would be good. Flights are quick, and frankly, the less time spent on board, the better. Flights between Bangkok and Siem Reap, however, are via Phnom Penh in both directions. That’s right, you practically fly over Siem Reap to reach the capital, you sit on the ground for 50 minutes, and then you continue your journey. From leaving Bangkok to reaching Siem Reap, it’s just shy of 3 hours. A direct flight takes only 40 minutes. Ask for a cup of water on Lanmei Airlines and you’re told to buy a bottle for $1. Ask for a blanket because the cabin is freezing and you’re told to buy one for $10! And when you buy something to eat, the menu shows a lovely fresh looking cheese and ham sandwich alongside fruit on its cover, yet neither are available for purchase. It’s a handful of hot meals, noodle snacks, snacks etc, all at ridiculously high prices. I found the aircraft, an Airbus A320, to be in an acceptable state. It was perfectly functional in the sense that my seat and everything around it worked, but it wasn’t entirely clean and there was an unidentifiable aroma in the cabin in boarding. Whatever it was, it wasn’t pleasant. The crew were acceptable but nothing outstanding. I lost count of the number of times - on the ground and in the air - that they hid behind their curtain in the forward galley. They would occasionally peer through a gap into the cabin but there was limited cabin presence and no interaction with customers. The biggest bugbear for me is how Lanmei Airlines seat customers travelling Bangkok to Siem Reap together, regardless of how busy the flights are, and others have commented on this. Even on our outbound flight, with a very light load, and just a scattering of passengers towards the rear of the aircraft, those of completing the entire trip were squashed in together at the front. It happened on the return flight too. But despite my moaning, the arrival into Bangkok was unbelievably smooth and quick, taking 15 minutes from disembarkation to arrivals - including immigration, baggage delivery and customs. Would I fly Lanmei again? Not between Bangkok and Siem Reap. The long journey along with the time on the ground is painful. But in and out of Phnom Penh, absolutely.
reviews.author: michaelkinghorn

reviews.title: Disgruntled Staff and Weird Policies
reviews.text: From the time of check in to the time getting seated, staff had little to no smile. The whole plane was around 20% full. Yet, they put my assigned seats so I was seated crammed in a row with others. I'm 2 meters tall. What kind of management would encourage people to check in all in the same row with such low occupancy? I attempted moving to an exit row, which was empty. Was told cannot. When sitting in this seat, one of my legs rests halfway in the isle, because it won't fit.
reviews.author: James J

reviews.title: Experience China in Cambodia
reviews.text: Always difficult to say your unhappy with the experience, since when is flying ever enjoyable?? I use Lanmei two to three times per month over the last year, so I have a fair data base. The issues are the overall level of the staff hospitality, thus my title. There is much attaitude with the service team, all parts ground and cabin staff, there is no understanding of hospitality or service. If you enjoy being treat like a moron, the hussle and bussle of a busy day at the great wall with all the requisit pushing and elbows then this may be for you. Lastly the confusion at deplaning once arrived as to who stays on and who should get off is always comical. That said their on time record is good and yes it's low cost.
reviews.author: mrdee999

reviews.title: 24 hours flight changed
reviews.text: Booked a flight on Dec 31st to spend NYE in Phnom Penh and flight was changed for no reason to Jan 1st, 24 hours later
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: No info on delayed flight and in reality not a reliable airline even in their HQ city as the ground staff is not even available to tell you something
reviews.author: KEDAR

reviews.title: Terrible Low-Cost company
reviews.text: I booked a flight with Lanmei Airlines as first segment of an international flight. I had an issue with my check-in baggage because Lanmei did not accept to check the baggage through my final destination. The reason they told me is that they are low-cost company and they cannot help even the ticket number is the same for the entire itinerary. At the end, the company refuted to allow me boarding the plane and did not refund the ticket, so I've lost the cost for the entire itinerary.
reviews.author: randrianarisoa

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Had read some terrible reviews online of this airline but we had a great experience. Check-in opened 100 mins before flight, it was quick and seamless. Flight took 35 minutes and staff were very helpful. A lovely experience.
reviews.author: Tom M

reviews.title: they cancel flights anytime
reviews.text: a few days before dep. i get email ...delayed...& 1 day later, next delay. too late for my flight to sin. i lost the money. my advice: never book a cambodian airline in advance when you have a departure time to continue. i was f...d up 3 times up to now. that's enough
reviews.author: Tom S

reviews.title: Unemployment a distinct possibility
reviews.text: I have been flying with Lanmei for more then a year now as we have a project in Siem Reap and I'm there regularly. On Sunday I was booked on the 08:15 flight I admit I arrived a bit late 07:48, when I approached the check in counter and asked if I could check in, (I could see the queue of people through the glass ready to board the flight. The desk staff said check-in is closed, I ask her to call the Lanmei supervisor she did, I ask him if I could please get on this flight it was important that I get to Phnom Penh he said no and then put the phone down on me. It was clear to me that this was pure attitude "No" attitude, no interest in helping regular customers, just "No" I have been in customer service all my career and if anyone from my team put the phone down on my customers, they would be unemployed. I will now do my best to avoid flying this airline, and of course repeat this story when ever asked about Lanmei airlines. You work so hard to get customers and bad attitude pushes them away shame on you.
reviews.author: mrdee999

reviews.title: Safe but expensive
reviews.text: The flight in rainy season, the landing was not possible at the 1st attempt. The captain announced about the un-descendable weather condition and immediate next action he was taking. The airplane circled over the airport for a while and landed beautifully at the 2nd attempt. The pilot was great but this short flight costed more than Siem Reap - Bangkok though.
reviews.author: bengmeliamo

reviews.title: Quiet ok by European standards
reviews.text: No frill Chinese Airline, plane was 17 years old, seats worn but all other interior and exterior in good shape. Crew very friendly.
reviews.author: SpSp

reviews.title: Hopeless service and very old aircraft.
reviews.text: Definitely will not fly with this hopeless mob ever again. No web check in. Imagine the queue at check in. Also check in supposed to open two hours before but it opened only 90 mins before and took over a hour in the queue to drop our bags. We pulled back over 30 mins late and of course what happens when you leave late you arrive late and there are no scheduled facilities. No buses to ferry us from aircraft to terminal - wait again. And then no suitcases for more than half an hour. A fifty minute hop turned into a three hours disaster. Spoiled the whole afternoon and evening for us. The aircraft is very shabby and the tightest legroom i have ever experienced.
reviews.author: mariomarkanders

reviews.title: WARNING>> They frequently cancel flights at short notice.
reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS AIRLINE !!! Absolutely disgusted. Chinese owned airline. Flight announcements only in Chinese and local Khmer language. Contrary to Cambodia labor laws, flight attendants were all Chinese. . Had booked return ticket from Siem Reap to Phnom Penh (Cambodia). I get an email night before return flight saying flight time changed. Rang the Lanmei phone number many times, pressed 6 for English as per the recording and disconnected. Could not contact them at all. Arrived at airport to find fight was cancelled and NOBODY from Lanmei at and desk to assist - just a TV screen saying Lanmei flight cancelled.. Went to information desk where airport staff advised that Lanmei cancel frequently. Information desk was able to call non-public phone number and i spoke with airline rep who says... "we can put you on standby. Maybe tomorrow or next day, but we promise we can get you on flight to Siem Reap within next 4 days"!! WTF !!! Totally uncaring and unprofessional airline. Had to buy a ticket on another air;line at huge price given last minute booking. Lanmei Airlines suck big time.. AVOID !!! AVOID !!! AVOID !!
reviews.author: Mango Villa

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I had to take flight from Siem Reap to Phnom Penh by LQ318 at 15:00. On that day, I left from hostel at 13:45 to airport but along the way was very traffic jam. At that time, I was arrived airport at 14:40, I was late 10mn only for check-in and the counter was closed at 14:30, since I ran to ask anyone assisting immediately but there was no one helped even staffs of airport. Then I saw an I-stand banner, I contacted to customer service number to assist me, when I called a lady was picked my phone up and I was informed her that I was late 10mn of check-in and counter were closed and how can I do if so. She replied to me pretty impolite that because you were late, the counter closed and we couldn't wait you, if so you had to pay for delayed time around $1000+. When I heard, I was very disappointing for airline staff said like this. If she spoke to me politely even she couldn't help me anything. It would be better than and I was not so frustrated. After that I asked staff of airport to ask for the airline staff on spot, they said that not excepted anymore since they were delayed their flight to take-off almost 15:25. Flight should have taken off since 15:00 but not. It was my worse experience to take flight this airline at the first time. If I was late and flight already taken off, I would not ask for help. Staff was worse and impolite to customer.
reviews.author: Sophearom T

reviews.title: Cheap flight and no hiccups
reviews.text: Booked a round trip from Phnom Penh to Siem Reap - this was the only available option for the timing I was looking into. Afterwards read the negative reviews here and in some other sites. However, despite the apprehension, the flight was on time, check-in and boarding was smooth and considering its a budget flight, no expectations and as such no complains about the actual flight. Both flights each way was full and didnt face any difficulty. For a roughly 50-mins of flight, I dont think its right to have much expectations either. Anyway, maybe compared to the other reviews, I was just lucky with the flights being on time each way.
reviews.author: Imranul H

reviews.title: Feb 2019 Experience
reviews.text: Cheap in every sense of the word! Pay for water in flight??? 5-hour late departure, for a 50-minute flight? No on-line check-in!
reviews.author: Robert V

reviews.title: Extortion.
reviews.text: I flew with my Wife and 7-month old baby to Sihanoukville Cambodia. The web booking does not accommodate bookings for Kids under 2 years. After being helped very nicely at Guangzhou airport we had a good holiday. On return, the child's ticket did not show on the system. The 2 Lanmei representatives insisted that we would have to buy 2 new tickets. one for the mother and 1 for the child. The assistants were both Chinese so they asked my wife who is Chinese to talk outside where it was implied that some money would help. When she refused all help ceased. They told the staff at the airport to not help us contact Lanmei office. When I took pictures they called security to threaten me. They then refused to even book the 2 extra tickets causing us to miss the flight and have to buy 3 new tickets with another airline and we had to find a Hotel for the night. I am still waiting for a response from the airline to my complaint.
reviews.author: crazee2015

reviews.title: Efficient and cheap
reviews.text: Had read a few reviews of lanmei but only after booking, which had made us worry. But, our flight was on time, the staff were lovely, check in and boarding was simple and we got to Siam reap in no time at all. Only slight issue was the airport suggesting the gate had closed before it had even started boarding, but I don’t think that was an airline issue. We checked our bags in 1.5 hours before the flight, but this was probably over cautious, especially as the flight only had around 30 passengers. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Yasmin H

reviews.title: Flights from Siem Reap to Phnom Penh
reviews.text: Very good check in, security checks and on time departure and arrival. Helpful staff. No problem at all, good value.
